description: Source code for managing multi-pack index (MIDX) files in a Git-like version control system, including loading, validation, and verification of MIDX files.

methods.name: midx_checksum_valid
methods.description: Validates the checksum of a multi-pack index (MIDX) file.

methods.name: clear_midx_files_ext
methods.description: Removes MIDX files with a specific extension, optionally keeping certain hashes.

methods.name: clear_incremental_midx_files_ext
methods.description: Removes incremental MIDX files with a specific extension, keeping specified hashes.

methods.name: cmp_idx_or_pack_name
methods.description: Compares a filename against an index or pack name for sorting/searching.

methods.name: get_midx_checksum
methods.description: Retrieves the checksum of a given MIDX.

methods.name: get_midx_filename
methods.description: Generates the filename for a MIDX based on source.

methods.name: get_midx_filename_ext
methods.description: Generates the filename for a MIDX with optional hash and extension.

methods.name: get_midx_chain_dirname
methods.description: Gets the directory name for a chain of MIDX files.

methods.name: get_midx_chain_filename
methods.description: Gets the filename for the chain of MIDX files.

methods.name: get_split_midx_filename_ext
methods.description: Generates filename for a split MIDX with hash and extension.

methods.name: load_multi_pack_index
methods.description: Loads a multi-pack index from disk, trying main file and chain.

methods.name: close_midx
methods.description: Closes and frees resources associated with a MIDX.

methods.name: verify_midx_file
methods.description: Verifies integrity and consistency of a MIDX file.

methods.name: clear_midx_file
methods.description: Removes the main MIDX file and associated auxiliary files.
